LnMH.rationale: Real make lint / CI gap: shadow-db-lint.sh provisions only mod-users' own migrations against a bare Postgres, missing mod-core's legal_entities/apps prereq schema that mod-users' migrations FK into; likely already failing CI silently for the same reason.
